name: memory-skills
description: Harness-neutral skills and CLI for a SQLite-backed Markdown memory vault
author: Soma Holiday <soma@somaholiday.com>

scripts.build: tsup src/cli.ts src/install.ts --format esm --platform node --out-dir dist --external better-sqlite3 --external sqlite-vec && node -e "for (const file of ['dist/cli.js', 'dist/install.js']) require('node:fs').chmodSync(file, 0o755)"
